prompt: Create a reusable BASE-COLOR MATERIAL texture for native 3D village walls, castle gates and medieval houses. Use the attached USER GAME REFERENCE as the actual visual style reference, specifically the chapel's warm neutral grey limestone, its readable hand-carved stones, refined edges, subtle material variety, and mature restrained painterly woodland fantasy mood. The texture will be applied consistently to actual 3D geometry with real dynamic lighting. Deliver ONE SQUARE seamless tile, 1024 by 1024 pixels, entirely filled with limestone masonry. FLAT FRONT-ON ORTHOGRAPHIC MATERIAL ONLY, absolutely no perspective, no isometric block or object, no environment, no foliage, no roof, no UI or text. Exactly EIGHT horizontal courses across the full tile height, each course 0.32 metres high, so the physical tile covers 2.56 by 2.56 metres. Mostly rectangular dressed stones of varied widths 0.4 to 0.8 metres, staggered running bond and believable narrow fine grey mortar joints; make all eight row boundaries horizontal and parallel, and make opposite edges repeat seamlessly. Match the reference's rich but quiet cut limestone: broad, subtly faceted stone planes, a few refined chipped edges, delicate chisel marks, small low-contrast mineral variations, clean material readability on mobile. Natural low saturation warm ivory grey, some muted cool grey and soft taupe stones, no yellow sandstone, no white marble, no dirty high-contrast speckles. Mature dark STYLIZED painterly game material in the visual genre of Diablo Immortal, never photographic, cute, pastel, toy bricks or heavily outlined. Uniform neutral diffuse illumination throughout. NO cast shadows, no directional sunlight, no baked highlights, no ambient spotlight or vignette, no dark bevel shadows or black outlines. Fine grey mortar is material color, with only subtle intrinsic stone relief cues. No cracks that span the whole tile, no moss patches, no decorative symbols. Color texture only; do not make or label a normal/roughness map. No border or gutter.

processing: Downsample the entire square source to 768x768 and encode WebP quality94. No painting, inpainting, color adjustment, source relighting, bump/normal synthesis or seam blending.
limitations: Generated base color retains subtle intrinsic edge/relief shading; it is not a measured PBR scan or a normal/roughness map. Prompt alone does not certify seamless repetition or visual improvement; source/runtime pixel dimensions, hashes and edge measurements are recorded by the packing worker and actual opposing-face renders are reviewed.
